description: Defines the ProcessedNodeInputs class, which provides a packed representation of input indices for ProcessedNode, including inline and outline storage mechanisms, with memory management and size optimizations.

classes.name: ProcessedNodeInputs
classes.description: A class that efficiently stores input indices for a node, using inline storage for small sizes and heap allocation for larger sizes, with memory alignment and packing optimizations.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses input index at specified position, with bounds checking.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of inputs stored.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if there are no inputs stored.
